@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import os
+import threading
+from queue import Queue
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue, TaskQueueManager
+from ansible.executor.process.worker import WorkerProcess
+from ansible.plugins.strategy import StrategySentinel, results_thread_main
+from ansible.utils.display import Display
+from ansible.utils.multiprocessing import context as multiprocessing_context
+
+
+def _send_from_fork(queue):
+    display = Display()
+    display.set_queue(queue)
+    display.display('from fork', stderr=True)
+
+
+def test_display_queue_routes_worker_call_and_preserves_arguments(monkeypatch):
+    display = Display()
+    assert isinstance(display._lock, type(threading.Lock()))
+    queue = Mock()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        display.set_queue(queue)
+
+    worker_pid = os.getpid() + 1
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.utils.display.os.getpid', lambda: worker_pid)
+    try:
+        display.set_queue(queue)
+        display.display('message', 'red', True, False, True, False)
+        queue.send_display.assert_called_once_with('message', 'red', True, False, True, False)
+    finally:
+        display._final_q = None
+
+
+def test_worker_installs_display_queue_before_running(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    display = Display()
+    worker = WorkerProcess.__new__(WorkerProcess)
+    worker._final_q = Mock()
+    worker._run = lambda: display.display('from worker', stderr=True)
+    worker_pid = os.getpid() + 1
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.utils.display.os.getpid', lambda: worker_pid)
+    try:
+        worker.run()
+        worker._final_q.send_display.assert_called_once_with('from worker', None, True, False, False, True)
+        assert capsys.readouterr() == ('', '')
+    finally:
+        display._final_q = None
+
+
+def test_fork_sends_display_while_parent_lock_is_held():
+    display = Display()
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    worker = multiprocessing_context.Process(target=_send_from_fork, args=(queue,))
+    display._lock.acquire()
+    try:
+        worker.start()
+        event = queue.get(timeout=5)
+        assert isinstance(event, DisplaySend)
+        assert event.args == ('from fork', None, True, False, False, True)
+        worker.join(timeout=5)
+        assert worker.exitcode == 0
+    finally:
+        display._lock.release()
+        if worker.is_alive():
+            worker.terminate()
+            worker.join(timeout=5)
+        queue.close()
+
+
+def test_final_queue_send_display_preserves_call():
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    try:
+        queue.put = Mock()
+        queue.send_display('message', color='red', stderr=True)
+        event = queue.put.call_args.args[0]
+        assert isinstance(event, DisplaySend)
+        assert event.args == ('message',)
+        assert event.kwargs == {'color': 'red', 'stderr': True}
+        assert queue.put.call_args.kwargs == {'block': False}
+    finally:
+        queue.close()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_dispatches_all_display_events(monkeypatch):
+    queue = Queue()
+    queue.put(DisplaySend('first', stderr=True))
+    queue.put(DisplaySend('second', newline=False))
+    queue.put(StrategySentinel())
+    strategy = Mock(_final_q=queue)
+    parent_display = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.plugins.strategy.display', parent_display)
+    results_thread_main(strategy)
+    assert parent_display.display.call_count == 2
+    parent_display.display.assert_any_call('first', stderr=True)
+    parent_display.display.assert_any_call('second', newline=False)
+
+
+def test_cleanup_flushes_both_streams(monkeypatch):
+    stdout = Mock()
+    stderr = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager.sys.stdout', stdout)
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager.sys.stderr', stderr)
+    tqm = TaskQueueManager.__new__(TaskQueueManager)
+    tqm._final_q = Mock()
+    tqm._terminated = False
+    tqm.cleanup()
+    stdout.flush.assert_called_once_with()
+    stderr.flush.assert_called_once_with()
